

== ALT publication and runtime identity ==

The published face is [[:File:V11-L-maketenmenfeellikeahundred_ai.gif]]. Its literal text, lore, stats and icons are kept on this ALT article. The family card UID remains <code>211_29</code>; the source deck's GEMP modifier is <code>211_29^</code>. The modifier selects the alternate image while gameplay resolves through the ordinary blueprint; it does not assign the face a numbered regular errata label. See [[Card versions]].

The ALT and current regular image both visibly print E1. The regular (Errata 3) page is the third chronological published regular image/state in its existing history; its literal printed mark remains E1. ALT wording matches regular (Errata 2) and (Errata 3), not original/playtest/(Errata). Record E1 only as a printed mark, not PC-E1/PC-E3 runtime allocation. The relevant regular source faces are [[:File:V11-L-maketenmenfeellikeahundred-20201014.gif]] and [[:File:V11-L-maketenmenfeellikeahundred.gif]].

The asset history proves this exact rendering existed before the [[2026 World Championship]]. The repository asset-commit date is retained as provenance; no physical-release date is assigned from it. The ALT navigator entry follows the ordinary Modern entry, before the Modern Errata entries.

The Set icon field records the symbols actually visible on this face, separately from gameplay icons and the publication set.
